name: release-tp3
description: Release measurement for three nodes (8 streams, 1M context), about 51 minutes a build: model behaviour on all 256 prompts at eight streams, the engine grid up to eight requests, eight and four streams in a closed loop, Poisson arrivals at 0.42 requests/s (about 80% of eight streams' rate on r6h) with goodput under a 2 s time to first token and 100 ms per output token, and real-text prefill at the ring's sizes, 32K to 1,000,000 tokens (both shapes serve 1M since r6x). Its grid needs the dev-mode collective RPC.
